title: Scaffolding Angular Momentum from Particle to Rigid Disc
physical_system: Rotating horizontal disc and particle angular momentum
pedagogical_objective: Scaffold understanding of angular momentum from an isolated particle in free fall about an offset origin to a coupled rigid body system (horizontal rotating disc with radial insect motion) undergoing variable moment of inertia and angular momentum conservation.

rungs.physical_delta: Baseline free particle angular momentum about external fixed point
rungs.transfer_requirement: Evaluating time-dependent angular momentum L = r x p for vertical free fall relative to a fixed ground origin not vertically below the particle.

rungs.physical_delta: Coupled rotating disc with radial insect motion causing time-varying moment of inertia
rungs.transfer_requirement: Applying isolated system angular momentum conservation I(t) omega(t) = const where internal mass relocation alters effective moment of inertia.
